description.zh: 任务的客户端唯一码，用来唯一标识一个任务。用于实现异步和幂等，创建时如果不指定，系统将自动生成，该代码将与资源ID进行唯一绑定。更新、删除资源时如果指定该参数，应与创建时的客户端唯一码保持统一。
description.en: The client unique code of the node, used to uniquely identify a node. This code is used to implement asynchronous operations and idempotence. If not specified during creation, the system automatically generates one, and the code is uniquely bound to the resource ID. When updating or deleting a resource, if this parameter is specified, it must be consistent with the client unique code used during creation.
The associated data source information.
The dependency information.

description.zh:
依赖类型。
- CrossCycleDependsOnChildren：跨周期依赖一级子节点
- CrossCycleDependsOnSelf：跨周期依赖自己
- CrossCycleDependsOnOtherNode：跨周期依赖其他节点
- Normal：同周期依赖
description.en:
The dependency type. Valid values:
- CrossCycleDependsOnChildren: cross-cycle dependency on first-level child nodes.
- CrossCycleDependsOnSelf: cross-cycle dependency on self.
- CrossCycleDependsOnOtherNode: cross-cycle dependency on other nodes.
- Normal: same-cycle dependency.

description.zh: 上游任务的输出标识符。（`同周期依赖`且设置input内容时，返回此字段）
description.en: The output identifier of the upstream node. This field is returned when the dependency type is same-cycle dependency and input content is configured.

description.zh: 上游任务的Id。（`跨周期依赖其他节点`与`同周期依赖`未设置input内容时，返回此字段，其他情况不返回）
description.en: The ID of the upstream node. This field is returned when the dependency type is cross-cycle dependency on other nodes, or same-cycle dependency without input content configured. It is not returned in other cases.
The description.

description.zh:
项目环境。
- Prod：生产
- Dev：开发
description.en:
The project environment. Valid values:
- Prod: production.
- Dev: development.
The node ID.
The input information.

description.zh:
实例生成模式。
- T+1（第二天生成）
- Immediately（立即生成）。注意：节点定时时间在节点发布时间点十分钟后的周期实例才会正常生成。全量转实例期间（22:00~24:00点期间）不能进行实时转实例，可以提交发布节点，但新增节点不会自动转出实例。
description.en:
The instance generation mode. Valid values:
- T+1: The instance is generated the next day.
- Immediately: The instance is generated immediately. Note: Only periodic instances whose scheduled time is at least ten minutes after the node publish time are generated normally. During the full instance generation period (22:00 to 24:00), real-time instance generation is not available. You can submit and publish nodes, but new nodes do not automatically generate instances.
The name.
The output information.
The account ID of the node owner.

description.zh: 重试时间间隔，单位毫秒。（不得超过1800000）
description.en: The retry time interval, in milliseconds. The value cannot exceed 1800000.

description.zh:
任务是否允许重跑的配置。
- AllDenied：失败或成功都不可重跑
- FailureAllowed：只有失败可重跑
- AllAllowed：失败或成功均可重跑
description.en:
Specifies whether the node can be rerun. Valid values:
- AllDenied: The node cannot be rerun regardless of whether it succeeds or fails.
- FailureAllowed: The node can be rerun only when it fails.
- AllAllowed: The node can be rerun regardless of whether it succeeds or fails.

description.zh: 重试次数，当任务设置为可重跑时生效。
description.en: The number of retries. This parameter takes effect when the node is configured to allow reruns.

description.zh: 运行环境配置，如资源组信息。
description.en: The environment configuration, such as resource group information.
The script information.
The list of node tags.
The tag key.
The tag value.

description.zh: 任务执行超时时间，单位秒。取值应大于3600。
description.en: The node execution timeout period, in seconds. The value must be greater than 3600.
The node trigger method.
